subsystems.name: Radionuclide
subsystems.role: the payload — an isotope whose decay deposits cell-killing energy over a range of a few millimetres (beta) or a few cell widths (alpha).
parts: reactor or accelerator target and separation chemistry

subsystems.name: Targeting vector
subsystems.role: finds the tumour and holds the isotope there long enough to matter.
parts: peptide or small-molecule ligand binding a surface receptor

subsystems.name: Chelator and conjugate
subsystems.role: grips the metal ion tightly so it does not escape into the body before decay.

subsystems.name: Radiolabelling and release
subsystems.role: joins isotope to vector in a single patient or batch dose, then proves the product is safe.
parts: HPLC and thin-layer chromatography for radiochemical purity

subsystems.name: Theranostic imaging and dosimetry
subsystems.role: a diagnostic twin of the drug shows where the receptor is and lets clinicians calculate absorbed dose to tumour and organs.
parts: PET tracer with a positron-emitting analogue

subsystems.name: Administration and radiation protection
subsystems.role: delivers the dose and manages the radioactive patient and waste.

buildSteps.title: Produce the isotope
buildSteps.detail: Lutetium-177 is made by neutron irradiation in a research reactor, then chemically separated from the target to very high specific activity; actinium-225 comes from thorium-229 generators or accelerator routes and is far scarcer.

buildSteps.title: Synthesise the vector
buildSteps.detail: Peptides are built by solid-phase synthesis and purified; antibody-based vectors are grown in cells and purified by chromatography.

buildSteps.title: Attach the chelator
buildSteps.detail: A DOTA-type cage is chemically coupled to the vector so it can hold the metal ion without blocking the receptor-binding end.

buildSteps.title: Radiolabel
buildSteps.detail: The isotope is heated with the conjugate in a buffered solution for minutes to tens of minutes; unbound isotope is removed on a cartridge or column.

buildSteps.title: Quality control and release
buildSteps.detail: Radiochemical purity, activity, identity, sterility and endotoxin are measured, and the batch is released against a pharmacopoeial specification within hours because the isotope decays.

buildSteps.title: Select the patient
buildSteps.detail: A PET scan with the diagnostic twin confirms the tumour expresses the target receptor strongly enough to justify treatment, and dosimetry estimates organ limits.

buildSteps.title: Infuse
buildSteps.detail: The dose is given intravenously, typically over minutes, with co-infusion of amino acids to protect the kidneys from reabsorbed peptide.

buildSteps.title: Monitor and manage
buildSteps.detail: Patients are scanned and blood-counted over following weeks for tumour response and marrow toxicity; contaminated waste is held until it decays.

prerequisites.why: without a cage that holds the metal ion in the bloodstream, the isotope irradiates healthy tissue instead of the tumour.
treatment works only in patients whose tumours actually express the receptor, so a paired imaging tracer is essential.
reactor and generator capacity for lutetium-177 is limited, and actinium-225 supply is a hard bottleneck for alpha therapy.
short-lived isotopes leave no time for manual handling and demand shielded, validated production.
dose is often given as a fixed activity; true personalisation needs better imaging and models.

pathway.milestone: lutetium-177 DOTATATE for neuroendocrine tumours and lutetium-177 PSMA-617 for prostate cancer in routine use
pathway.unlocks: systemic radiation therapy as an accepted oncology modality.

pathway.milestone: alpha emitters reach late-stage trials and approval
pathway.unlocks: killing of individual residual cells and less dependence on receptor density, with less crossfire damage to healthy tissue.

pathway.milestone: use earlier in the treatment pathway and in combination with other drugs
pathway.unlocks: larger patient populations and better outcomes before tumours become resistant.

pathway.milestone: scaled actinium-225 production and dosimetry-guided dosing
pathway.unlocks: reliable supply and safer, personalised activity for alpha therapy.
